distribution.narrative: Accepted for Taiwan from Beaver & Liu (2010). No mainland China occurrence is promoted from this source record.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) explicitly reports Toxicodendron trichocarpum, Celastrus articulata, Quercus acutissima and Phellodendron sachalinensis. These source-supported species-level associations are promoted without taxonomic expansion.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Eidophelus imitans Eichhoff, 1876.
